svg.title: Choose a drawing format for the job
svg.desc: A cutting machine needs a path to follow. A photo stores an image as a grid of colored pixels. Vector. An SVG describes shapes and lines that can be resized. Raster. A photo has a fixed grid. Enlarging it makes the pixels easier to see. Check. Open the file in the intended app and inspect it at the size you will use.
svg.text: Choose a drawing format for the job
A cutting machine needs a path to follow. A photo stores an image as a grid
An SVG describes shapes and lines that can be resized.
A photo has a fixed grid. Enlarging it makes the pixels easier to see.
Open the file in the intended app and inspect it at the size you will use.
